name: hcportal_approveKennelRequest
description: Approves a kennel request (E12.F1.S6): creates HC.Kennel (unique short name LH3 / LH3-GB / LH3-GBn, coin logo URL, parsed price), makes the requester HC admin (account created if the email has none), adds CanEditKennel platform admins as helpers, ensures an invite code, marks the request approved. UPDLOCK on the request row. Requires HC.PlatformAdmin with CanEditKennel = 1 (E12.F1). Visitors' price from NonMemberPrice when numeric, else the members' price. Membership: MembershipPrice / MembershipRenewalMode from the request (none ⇒ price 0, rolling).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Portal token; standard param string (device secret).

rowsets.name: Success
rowsets.description: { Success, ErrorMessage } — also the auth / CanEditKennel refusal.

rowsets.name: ApprovedKennel (success only)
rowsets.description: PortalApiHC6 emails the welcome with InviteCode, then REMOVES InviteCode and adds WelcomeEmailSent before replying.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Hasher + HC.LaunchAndLogin when the email is new (trgInsertHkmRecordForHomeHash adds the home HKM row)
INSERT/UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap: requester AppAccessFlags 1073741887, HcWebPermissionFlags 127, no mismanagement roles; helpers the same, IsMember 0
API: welcome email via the Logic App
breakingChangesVsHc3w: No dbo.Users login / hard-coded password hash
Logo is a blob URL, not bundle://
Helpers from HC.PlatformAdmin, not a hard-coded id
Requester gets HC admin only, not all mismanagement roles
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
